name: Foundations
blurb: MDPs, value functions, policy gradients, actor-critic, trust regions, PPO. Every other track builds on these.

name: Classical RL
blurb: The environment gives the reward. Off-policy and model-based methods, exploration, multi-agent RL, world models, meta-RL, robotics.

name: RLHF
blurb: People compare two outputs, a reward model learns from the comparisons, and PPO, DPO, and their relatives optimize against it.

name: RLAIF
blurb: An LLM judge or a written constitution stands in for the human labeler.

name: RLVR and reasoning
blurb: A checker decides: the answer matches, the tests pass. Reasoning models, process vs outcome rewards, and how verifiers get gamed.

name: Agentic RL
blurb: Multi-step tasks with tools, browsers, and code. The reward usually arrives at the end, so credit assignment gets hard.

name: Offline RL
blurb: Learning from a fixed dataset with no new interaction, including imitation and distillation.

name: Systems
blurb: How LLM-RL training runs: distributed rollouts and learners, inference engines, hardware.
